title: (II) COSMOGONY: The creation of the Ten Firmaments
english_translation:
[R/Hd] [ ... ] remission of sins to

[The Father orders the Spiritus vivens to create the world] ... and make them pure from the evil poison and purify (them), and lead them up again to the Light-Paradise. Thereupon at once (70) the Lord of the seven Climes and the Mother of the Righteous began to plan how to arrange the world. Then they began to fashion it. First they made Five (75) Rugs *; there they seated the Splendid-tenens. Thereunder they formed ten Firmaments, set up one magic twelve-faced Lens. There they seated (80) a Son of God as watcher, so that in all the ten Firmaments the demons could do no harm. Furthermore he (sic) evoked (created) forty angels, (85) who hold the ten Firmaments upraised. In each firmament they fashioned twelve Gates; another four Gates each they constructed in the four directions, there where (90) those angels stand. The thickness of the Firmament is ten myriad parasangs; again, (the thickness of) their air is one myriad parasangs. (95) To each of the twelve Gates that exist in each of the Firmaments they constructed six Thresholds, to each Threshold thirty bazaars, [V/Hd] the toil-weary [ ... ]

[V] in each Bazaar twelve Rows*, [in each Row* two Sides*]; to the one Side* they made (100) one hundred and eigthty Stalls*, to the other Side* (another) one hundred and eighty. In every Stall* they fettered and enclosed yaksas and demons, the males separately from (105) the females. Thereupon the Living Spirit (Wisparkar 'all-maker') called the Lord of the Firmaments. They seated him on a throne in the seventh heaven and made him the lord and king over the (110) ten Firmaments. Then, below the ten Firmaments, they fashioned a rolling wheel and (sic) zodiac. Within the zodiac they fettered those of the demons of Darkness that were (115) the most iniquitous, viscious, and rebellious. The twelve constellations (signs) and the seven planets they made rulers over the whole Mixed World, (120) and set them in opposition to each other. From all the demons that had been imprisoned in the zodiac they wove to and fro the roots, veins, and links. (125) In the lowest Firmament they bored a hole and suspended the zodiac from it. Two Sons of God were placed by them (there) as watchers, so as to ... the Superior Wheel continually.
